references.text: Mark 1:2 refers to Isaiah 40:3, where it speaks of one crying out in the wilderness and preparing the way for the Lord, which is connected with John the Baptist's role in preparing for Jesus' ministry.
Mark 1:2 also contains a reference to Exodus 23:20 about sending an angel ahead to guard the way, which can be seen as a parallel to sending a messenger ahead of Jesus.
Although Mark 1:2 explicitly mentions Isaiah, it is understood that Malachi 3:1 is also relevant since it speaks of sending a messenger to clear the way, which corresponds with the message in Mark.
